What We Do

Specialized Cleaning & Staffing Built for High-Volume Kitchens

From nightly restaurant sanitation to full commercial kitchen deep cleans, Ecco Clean keeps your facility inspection-ready, safe, and running without interruption.

Commercial Kitchen Deep Cleaning

Our specialty. We degrease, sanitize, and detail every surface of your commercial kitchen so it passes health inspections and stays code-compliant.

  • Hoods, exhaust & ventilation degreasing
  • Ovens, fryers, grills & equipment
  • Floors, drains & grout sanitation
  • Walk-in coolers & storage areas
  • Grease, grime & buildup removal
  • Power washing & pressure cleaning

Kitchen & Labor Staffing

Trained, dependable kitchen labor when you're short-staffed — from dishwashers to prep cooks and chefs, ready to step in fast.

  • Dishwashers & porters
  • Prep cooks & line support
  • Chefs & general labor
  • Short-term & ongoing coverage
Kitchen & Labor Staffing
